We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: Person (何某) signs a rental agreement with the actual car owner (郭某某) for a taxi, paying monthly rent. Then he deceives another person (马某某) by claiming he is the car owner, signs a rental agreement, collects a year's rent and deposit (total 50,600). Later the real owner reclaims the car. The victim asks for rent and deposit, he refuses. So he fraudulently obtained money by false representation, using contract. This is contract fraud (合同诈骗) as seen in earlier examples. The examples: first case about contract fraud gave answer "合同诈骗". So likely the crime is "合同诈骗". Also possibly "诈骗" generally, but they differentiate contract fraud as a specific crime under fraud. The description: "在签订、履行合同过程中，采取虚构事实、隐瞒真相的手段，骗取他人财物" matches contract fraud. So answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法占有" is part of fraud. No other crimes like "非法经营" etc. So single crime.
